title: Nova Genera Plantarum
author: Heinrich Adolph Schrader (1767-1836)
notes: Schrader's pars prima (Leipzig, 1797), the only part published. Contains early formal descriptions of slime mould genera with hand-coloured engraved plates, made in the years when Persoon was fixing the nomenclature the group still uses. Short, never translated, and a plate source as much as a text. First-translation candidate. Collection: slime-moulds, mycology. Source: archive.org, Missouri Botanical Garden copy, 48 images.

title: The Myxomycetes of Great Britain, arranged according to the method of Rostafinski
author: Mordecai Cubitt Cooke (1825-1914)
notes: The book that carried Rostafinski's classification into English practice, seventeen years before Lister's monograph (London, 1877). The title states the debt outright. A working British flora of the group with 24 plates, and the bridge between the Polish monograph almost nobody could read and the English one everybody did. Collection: slime-moulds, mycology. Source: archive.org, MBLWHOI Library copy, 164 images.

title: Monograph of the Myxogastres
author: George Massee (1845-1917)
notes: Massee's arrangement of the group (London, Methuen, 1892), with twelve coloured plates. Published two years before Lister's monograph and largely superseded by it, which is the interest: the two together show the classification being argued rather than settled. Collection: slime-moulds, mycology. Source: archive.org, University of Toronto copy, 412 images.
